node.title: Re^2: eval '...'; die "err: $!"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You might have cribbed that from an idiom, like: open my $fh, q{<}, $file || die $!

That's not an idiom, it's wrong because of incorrect precedence: [id://11102684].

Also, just in case you're implying otherwise, eval or die is a decent approach to work around [id://1153468].

Update: [id://17557|It is uncool to update a node in a way that renders replies confusing or meaningless]. Mark your updates. Update 2: Now fixed.
